notes.title: Interface Update
notes.content:
Hello players,

This update brought changes mainly in the interface. Following are the changes:

Fear Bar, Goal and Controls

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29517367/dafe4928eb1a44371f8f0171a58b695004243d84.png


 Fear Bar: The position was changed to the top. This help the player to stay tuned along with goals.
 Your Goal: This information will clear to you what your goal at the moment.
 Controls: This will greatly help new players.


Items Collected and Scores

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29517367/718e6b426bba862376d6aa49341fb2ccbfb72cb2.png


 Items Collected:These counters show the amount of items that were collected during this gameplay and will help track the performance to unlock the achievements of the Steam.
 Scores: The scores of the sum total of life time points (Rush), your best score during a gameplay and your current score.


Pop Up Values

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29517367/0916d4bf609f844bec6f18d1ff16b7f13d196f38.png

This information is displayed when you collect an item showing the value of the fear, life and item points you acquired when you picked it up.

I hope you like.

Developer

notes.title: Jump & Improvements
notes.content:
Hello players! This update brought a new experience. See the changes below:

 Jump - The character gained the ability to jump. Which brings you the opportunity to reach the items faster and dodge from others unwanted items.
 Change in item drop rate - The drop speed varies according to the bar of fear. More fear, more drop. The amount of skulls increased and hearts / potions reduced significantly.
 Start Screen - The start screen show the commands available in the game.
 Menu/Pause - During the game, press "Escape" to pause or quit.
 Heartbeat Sounf Effect - The heart beat plays constantly and increases / decreases according to the bar of fear.


I hope you enjoy it and waiting your feedback!

Developer
